assertions.text: Tests use @Test(arguments:) parameterised cases — not one test function per case, and not a loop over cases inside a single test body.
Test function bodies contain no for/while loops or forEach — cases are supplied via @Test(arguments:), not iterated manually.
Test function bodies contain no if/switch/guard branching — expected outcomes come from the argument rows, not branching logic.
assertions.evidence: No if/switch/guard statements in @Test function bodies

assertions.text: Each case reads as a coherent row pairing input with expected outcome — labelled tuple elements, a row struct, or zip of collections — not multiple independent collections passed to arguments: (which Swift Testing combines as a cartesian product) and not parallel arrays indexed manually.
assertions.evidence: (daysBeforeCheckIn: 30, expectedFee: 0), (daysBeforeCheckIn: 29, expectedFee: 500), ... as labelled tuples in one arguments array

assertions.text: Every fee tier is represented (free, 50%, 80%, full value) and every boundary is tested from both sides: 30 days (free) vs 29 days (50%), 7 days (50%) vs 6 days (80%), 1 day (80%) vs 0 days (full value). Middle-tier boundaries (7/6 and 1/0) must not be skipped in favour of only the outer edges.
assertions.evidence: (daysBeforeCheckIn: 30, expectedFee: 0), (daysBeforeCheckIn: 29, expectedFee: 500), (daysBeforeCheckIn: 7, expectedFee: 500), (daysBeforeCheckIn: 6, expectedFee: 800), (daysBeforeCheckIn: 1, expectedFee: 800), (daysBeforeCheckIn: 0, expectedFee: 1000)

assertions.text: The started-stay case is expressed as its own test using #expect(throws:) — not mixed into the fee table via sentinel values, optional expectations, or branching inside the test body.
assertions.evidence: @Test("Cancellation after the stay has started", arguments: [-1, -2, -10])\n... #expect(throws: CancellationError.stayAlreadyStarted)

assertions.text: Case values are concrete domain values (days like 29, fees like 100 for a 200-euro booking) — not abstract placeholders, computed expressions like bookingValue / 2, or symbolic constants that hide the actual numbers from the reader.
swift build --build-tests succeeds against the package scaffolding
